newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong fire kills 29, injures 77 - government.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong fire kills 29, injures 77 - government.

text.p: A blaze in a Hong Kong commercial building killed 29 people and injured 77, the government said on Thursday.

The death toll rose after 17 charred bodies were found on the 15th floor of the building in Nathan Road in the heart of the bustling Kowloon tourist district more than 16 hours after the fire broke out on Wednesday.
About 200 firefighters equipped with breathing apparatus and 38 fire engines were still battling the blaze on Thursday morning, the government said.
Fire and heavy smoke hampered efforts to search for scores missing and believed trapped in the 16-storey building.
Helicopters were called in to winch terrified survivors from the flames on Wednesday night.
Others jumped from window ledges onto rescue ladders and some scrambled onto ledges and air conditioners to escape one of the worst commercial building fires to hit Hong Kong in recent years.
